content.title: Certifications & Standards Compliance
content.content:
SnapLogic maintains enterprise security and compliance certifications required for deployment in regulated industries including aerospace manufacturing:

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.18.42.png:Certifications and Compliance Standards]

**SOC 2 TYPE II** — Security, Availability, Confidentiality

SnapLogic holds SOC 2 Type II certification covering security, availability, and confidentiality trust principles. The SOC 2 audit is performed annually by an independent third-party auditor and covers SnapLogic's cloud-hosted Manager control plane.

**ISO 27001:2013** — Information Security Management

SnapLogic is ISO 27001:2013 certified for information security management, demonstrating systematic management of sensitive company and customer information with risk-based controls.

**GDPR COMPLIANCE** — European Data Protection

SnapLogic is GDPR compliant for processing European personal data. For {{customer_name}}, the Ground Plex on-premises deployment ensures that all customer data remains within {{country}} and does not transit SnapLogic cloud infrastructure — providing data sovereignty and GDPR compliance by design.

**SECURITY PRACTICES**

- Annual penetration testing by independent security firms
- Vulnerability scanning and patch management with SLA-based remediation
- Secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) with automated security testing in CI/CD pipelines
- Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) for all data
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and single sign-on (SSO) support

**ITAR & EXPORT CONTROL SUPPORT**

For aerospace customers with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) requirements, SnapLogic's on-premises Ground Plex deployment ensures compliance by keeping all data processing within customer-controlled infrastructure. No data transits SnapLogic cloud, and all connector credentials are encrypted and stored locally.

| ISO 27001 | ISO/IEC 27001:2013 | Information Security Management | Annual |

[/TABLE]
